_comment: Only needed for a site on a DIFFERENT machine from the Command Center. You normally never write this by hand — adding a site with the 'another machine' runner gives you a one-line installer that creates it. Everything else about the site is configured in the browser.
_workDir: Scratch directory kept inside the app directory: staging builds, the rollback snapshot, the file manifest. Never touched by a deploy.
_appDir: Leave blank to use whatever the Command Center says. Set it to pin this machine to one directory that cannot be changed remotely.
_autoStart: Only used when the restart mode is 'supervised': start the app as soon as the agent has its settings.
